title: Call Sign Courage
overview: Call Sign Courage tells the story of courageous military whistleblower, Lt Col Matt Lohmeier, who stood up for his beliefes in the face of partisan corruption & the spread of cultural Marxism in the Military and was fired from his command for speaking out - only to be redeemed four years later and placed back in a position of authority when President Trump named him as the Undersecretary of the Air Force, now overseeing the same commanders who sought to silence him.

trailers.title: OFFICIAL TRAILER | CALL SIGN COURAGE: THE MATT LOHMEIER STORY
